observed.front: Apr2019 Street View (uMQ8, h111; ref 1139-lot, ~38-42 m across parked cars, medium): pale blue-grey lap siding, navy doors, grey walled courts with navy caps beside the doors (matched to the module doors: courts on the NE pair and the first SW pair enclose the lower-station door, the second SW pair the upper), the stepped gable. Dark brown roof from the undated overhead (medium).
observed.rear: Jan2023 (662G, h329; ref 1139-rear, ~25 m): upper windows above a tall wood fence; the lower storey and yard doors are production_inference.

study_notes.eave: Wall top 7.7 = frozen flat base 2.4 + 5.3 m from dated photo proportions (production_inference); source height 6 m retained as identity only
study_notes.limits: Fences, vent pipes, post bands, carport-top finish (shared canopy uses the roof material), finish materials, site and decals parked for later levels. No recognition or stage acceptance claim.
